parsedContent.correctedAnswer: Business needs working capital for purchasing raw materials, paying wages and salaries, meeting day-to-day expenses, and providing credit obligations. The costs of investing in debtors include Collection Cost, Capital Cost, Administrative Cost, and Default Cost. In a competitive environment, these costs are unavoidable because businesses must provide credit facilities to customers to remain competitive.
